title: Reversing every deposit unlocks the Bill To
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer C, another customer to try as Bill To.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Approved, billed to customer B, holding one deposit of $10.00 taken on its Finance tab after customer B was picked.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the Finance tab.
  3. Reverse the $10.00 deposit.
  4. Expand the Customer card.
  5. Click the Bill To field.
  6. Pick customer C in the list.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The Finance tab lists the $10.00 deposit.

Step 3:

  • The deposit is reversed.

Step 4:

  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer B's name.

Step 5:

  • The list opens: the field is no longer locked.

Step 6:

  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer C's name.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12307 (Story 5, Locked Bill To: invoiced and deposits)

  • S5-R8: “After the invoice is reversed, or all deposits are reversed, the field unlocks.”
